verdict: Organic visibility declining across all three locations; paid channels remain offline.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your three locations — Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals — generated a combined 420 Google Business Profile actions (calls, direction requests, and web clicks) with no paid advertising running on Meta or Google Ads. GBP engagement dropped sharply in the most recent 7 days, falling 57% at Forte, 77% at Advance Grinding, and 32% at O'Hare compared to the prior 7-day period, with all three locations recording zero GBP actions on each of the last three days — a confirmed trend, not a data blip. The decline mirrors a parallel drop in search clicks, pointing to reduced local search visibility across the group. Site reindexing and listing optimisation are in progress now with the goal of reversing this by month end, and outreach sequences are being prepared to activate the contact pipeline in parallel.
